name: N,N,4-Trimethylbenzenamine
description: N,N,4-Trimethylbenzenamine (CAS 99-97-8 ), commercially known as N,N-Dimethyl-p-toluidine or DMPT, is a tertiary aromatic amine used primarily as a chemical accelerator and curing agent across polymer and coating systems. It activates peroxide-based initiators at ambient temperatures, enabling room-temperature cure without external heat input. In acrylic and methacrylate adhesive systems, DMPT accelerates the free-radical polymerization. Initiated by benzoyl peroxide, it is a standard component in two-part structural adhesives and dental materials. Printing ink formulators use it to promote rapid cure in UV and peroxide-cured ink systems. This is essential where press-speed and substrate adhesion are critical. In fiber-reinforced polymer composites and casting resins, it enables cold-cure processing for parts where elevated-temperature post-curing is impractical. DMPT also functions as an intermediate in synthesizing dyes and pigments, particularly azo-type colorants used in plastics and packaging materials. It is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid in standard drums. Technical grade is the predominant commercial specification, with purity levels typically at 98–99%+ by GC. Bulk availability supports both industrial compounders and smaller specialty formulators. This ensures consistent amine activity across batches for various industrial applications.
